help.title: Help & support
help.faq_1_question: How do I share my digital card?
help.faq_1_answer: You can share your card via a QR code, a direct link, or an NFC card. Tap “Share” on the home screen.
help.faq_2_question: What is the difference between plans?
help.faq_2_answer: The free plan includes one profile and a limited number of clients. The paid plan unlocks multiple profiles and advanced features.
help.faq_3_question: How does the NFC card work?
help.faq_3_answer: Link your profile to the card, then use your digital profile as usual. Supported on iPhone 7 and later and NFC-enabled Android devices.
help.faq_4_answer: Yes, your data is kept secure here, with full control through the advanced settings screen.
help.faq_5_question: How do I delete my account?
help.faq_5_answer: Go to: Settings → Help & support → Contact us, and request account deletion. We are sorry to see you go — we never sell your data to anyone.
help.help_note: Support team is available Sunday to Thursday, 9 AM to 6 PM

privacy.intro: At Silink we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This page explains how we collect, use and protect your data when you use the app.
privacy.collect_body: We collect the data you provide directly, such as your name, phone number, email, digital profile details, contact links and the products and services you add, along with some technical data like device type and app language to improve your experience.
privacy.usage_body: We use your data to create and display your digital profile, power your NFC cards and QR codes, process orders and subscriptions, contact you about your account, and develop and improve our services.
privacy.sharing_body: We never sell your personal data to third parties. Others only see the information you choose to show on your public profile. We may share limited data with trusted service providers (such as payment and shipping) only as needed to deliver the service, or when legally required.
privacy.security_body: We protect your data with encrypted connections between the app and our servers, store sensitive sign-in data in secure encrypted storage on your device, and apply technical and organizational measures to prevent unauthorized access, modification or disclosure.
privacy.rights_body: You can view and edit your data at any time inside the app, control what appears on your public profile, and request deletion of your account and data by contacting support.
privacy.updates_body: We may update this policy from time to time and will notify you in the app of any significant changes. Continuing to use the app after an update means you accept the updated policy.
privacy.contact_body: If you have any questions about privacy or the security of your data, you can reach us through the Help & Support page in the app.

security.intro: The security of your account and data is our priority. Here is how we protect you, plus tips to keep your account safe.
security.account_body: You sign in with your mobile number and a one-time verification code (OTP) sent directly to you. Your session token is kept in encrypted storage on your device, and you are signed out automatically when the session expires.
security.encryption_body: All data exchanged between the app and our servers travels over an encrypted connection (HTTPS), preventing anyone else from intercepting or reading it.
security.visibility_body: You decide what appears on your public profile. You can add, hide or delete contact channels, links, products and services at any time, and others only see what you choose to show.
security.cards_body: Your card and QR code only contain the link to your public profile and never store sensitive data. If you lose your card, contact support to unlink it from your account.
security.payments_body: Payments are processed by certified, secure payment providers, and we never store your bank card details on our servers.
security.tips_title: Tips to keep your account safe
security.tips_body: Never share your verification code with anyone, even if they claim to be from Silink. Sign out of shared devices and keep the app updated to the latest version.
security.report_body: If you notice unusual activity on your account or suspect a security issue, contact us right away through the Help & Support page and we will handle it as a priority.

terms.intro: Welcome to Silink. By using the app you agree to the following terms of use, so please read them carefully.
terms.acceptance_body: Registering in the app or using any of its services constitutes your explicit agreement to these terms and to the privacy policy. If you do not agree with any of them, please do not use the app.
terms.account_body: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you provide and for keeping it up to date, for keeping your verification code confidential, and for all activity carried out through your account.
terms.usage_body: You may not use the app to publish unlawful, offensive or misleading content, impersonate any person or entity, infringe the intellectual property rights of others, or attempt to harm the app or its servers.
terms.content_body: You keep ownership of the content you add (such as images, text and products) and grant Silink permission to display it on your public profile according to your settings. You are responsible for its legality and accuracy.
terms.orders_body: Card orders and subscriptions are subject to the prices and features shown at the time of purchase. Subscriptions renew according to the selected plan, and you can manage your subscription inside the app.
terms.ip_body: All rights to the app, its design, logo, brand and original content are reserved by Silink and may not be copied or reused without prior written permission.
terms.termination_body: We may suspend or terminate any account that violates these terms without prior notice. You can also request to close your account at any time by contacting support.
terms.liability_body: We strive to provide the service with the highest quality and availability, but the app is provided "as is" and we are not liable for indirect damages resulting from temporary service interruptions or misuse.
terms.changes_body: We may update these terms from time to time and will notify you in the app of any significant changes. Continuing to use the app after an update means you accept the revised terms.
terms.law_body: These terms are governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

about.intro: Silink is a Saudi smart digital business card platform that helps individuals and companies share their professional identity with a single tap, in a modern, elegant and eco-friendly way.
about.offer_body: A professional digital profile that brings your contact details, links, products and services together in one place, with NFC cards and QR codes to share it instantly without paper cards.
about.individuals_body: Create your profile in minutes, choose the template and colors that represent you, and share your card with clients and contacts with a single tap on their phone.
about.companies_body: A public page for your company with its products and services, and team card management from one dashboard with a unified brand identity.
about.mission_body: To make professional networking easier, faster and more sustainable through simple digital solutions that give every person and every business a professional presence.
about.vision_body: To be the leading digital professional identity platform in the region and to contribute to a paperless future.
about.contact_body: We always love to hear your feedback and suggestions. Reach us any time through the Help & Support page in the app.
